about:
I help engineering organisations ship better software faster. Not by adding process, but by building the platforms, practices, and teams that remove friction from product delivery.

My career spans software development, systems architecture, and technology delivery leadership across financial services and enterprise technology. From hands-on engineering through to leading transformations at scale, I bring the depth to understand hard technical problems and the breadth to connect engineering decisions to customer outcomes.

At ClearRoute, I lead delivery across Australia for platform engineering, DevSecOps, and Quality Engineering engagements. I help clients modernise their engineering platforms, improve developer experience, and build sustainable delivery capability with a focus on measurable outcomes like faster onboarding, shorter feedback loops, and improved DORA metrics.

I lead with transparency, energy, and a bias toward measurable outcomes. I care about developer experience, sustainable delivery capability, and growing the next generation of engineering leaders.
